request.prompt: ONE LARGE SHIELD-BREAK STAGGER AND RECOVERY for this SAME Ash Warden. Begin in supplied stationary ritual stance with one palm raised and huge greatsword LOW. Suddenly a powerful invisible shield-breaking impulse JERKS BOTH SHOULDER PLATES, HELMET AND UPPER CHEST BACKWARD. His open hand recoils outward, BOTH KNEES BEND under enormous armor weight, torso briefly arches back and loses balance. Then he lowers chest and leans forward onto his greatsword for support, both gauntlets touch the ONE hilt, blade rests toward lower left. A real deep crouching braced pose, supporting boot plants firmly, one heavy rebalancing step is allowed. Hold the low exhausted stance briefly, then slowly stand upright and bring the sword and both hands to the original normal LOW SWORD COMBAT IDLE, not to raised casting hand. Distinct articulated shoulder recoil, bent knees, hip lowering, sword brace, and controlled recovery. This is a major phase event NOT a small hurt blink, NOT walking, NOT attack, NOT overhead sword swing. Exact same charcoal armor, original helmet and fiery visor, orange cracks, dry branches, ash tabard, broad heavy sword. No redesign. No shield or beam in the sprite, no particles, smoke, fire, flashes, scenery or dust. Full body, branches and blade stay inside original 192x192 canvas. Fixed South top-down camera; stationary root, no zoom or per-frame resizing. Transparent isolated character.
